notes.title: 2024 General Update
notes.notes:
[b]Hello,[/b]

I have prepared for you a new package of corrections and additions to our bestseller DESKTOP FARM live wallpaper.

Thanks to the wonderful community, we received problem reports and new ideas that needed to be implemented.

I have published a large patch for 2024 that improves and beautifies Desktop Farm.

This is my and the 3DM devs' thank you for 70,000 copies of the game sold.

[b]The patch includes:[/b]
1. Rewritten many lines of code for better optimization.

2. Replaced game shaders for better appearance and performance.

3. Fixed bugs reported by players.

4. New crops added. (Tomatoes, Onions)

5. New animals added. (Chicken, Duck)

6. Music added. (10 relaxing songs)

7. Added ability to change post-production effects. (4 types)

8. Improved buying and selling system.

9. Improved day and night system (real-time to your clock).

10. Improved game blocking system when you start another game, giving you 100% power.

Thank you once again to everyone who believed in this project and to those who didn't, which made me want to do it even more ;)

Making a functional game as a live wallpaper that works with Windows wasn't easy, but it was worth it.

[b]This patch had to be created. For all of you.[/b]

Just press "Update" please ;D

[b]Best Regards,[/b]
3DM Greg

notes.title: The BIG update 5
notes.notes:

notes.title: The BIG update 4
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38202331/1970541b2324323bccad43213a3273f5a82e5c49.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hi,[/h1]

Yes, The BIG update 3 had to be the last one but we had to tweak a few things and add requests of our supporters.

By my mistake, the previous versions didn't check and set your Windows settings properly. Some people had a problem with control over the game. This problem has gone. Every system will be checked now. The game will set everything for you, just follow the steps if the wrong setting will be detected. DesktopFarm needs it to work as interactive wallpaper.

[h2]List of changes:[/h2]

[h3]Updated Chinese language.[/h3]
Thanks to one of our user from China we could improve translations.
The full list of used words is published in the News section. Fill it if you want to help us with your language. Thanks!

[h3]Proper System check.[/h3]
The game will detect your Windows10 settings and will change it if needed. 

[h3]Steam Connect fix.[/h3]
Fixed Steam Connects. Uncheck it and turn off and on the game. Desktop Farm status will be hidden on Steam.

[h3]Clear road.[/h3]
Now you can build a road without any lines.

[h3]Camera rotation and angle fix.[/h3]
Now the camera rotation will be more smooth. Changing angle will keep the camera level to avoid upside-down position.

[h3]Camera reset icon.[/h3]
Now you have the icon to reset camera angles.

[h3]Map reset warning.[/h3]
Now you will see a warning before you reset the entire game.

Probably something more....


[b][u]Thank you for all information, feedback and ideas.[/u][/b]

[b]Best Regards[/b]
3DM

[h3][b]- We improved road construction.[/b][/h3]
The icons have been fixed.

Probably something else, but I don't remember now.

Thanks for reporting bugs, issues or interesting ideas. :D

Peace,

3DM

notes.title: The BIG update 2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38202331/5c1d092d65166aea190307bed59be0a955c024a0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hey.[/h1]

The project turned out to be quite a success so we got more feedback from you with new ideas and bug fixes. We are very grateful for any suggestions or reporting bugs.

[h1]What we improved/fixed:[/h1]

[b][h3]- The saving system is new.[/h3][/b]
Unfortunately, there was a problem with the fencing, so a new recording system was created to avoid this problem.

[b][h3]! We recommend restarting the map from the menu.[/h3][/b] The reset will restart the wallpaper! then you will lose your current farm. We do not require it but recommend that you restart the map.

[b][h3]- The auto pause system is new.[/h3][/b]
We've improved game pause so you have full computer power for your normal games. When you enable them, DesktopFarm will save and stop. After returning to the desktop, Desktop Farm will start working again.

[b][h3]Automatic pause recognizes most games but some require pausing from the main menu.[/h3][/b]

[b][h3]-Grow plants and cows.[/h3][/b]
We have slightly improved the system responsible for growing plants and cows.
The system is so efficient that it will allow you to quickly harvest your crops and earn money.

[b][h3]-Sliding and removing the house.[/h3][/b]
Now you can move and delete the main house. The improved system will allow the house to be better adapted to the map.


[b]-probably some more and new update will be soon.[/b]


[h1]FAQ[/h1]
[b]DesktopFarm doesn't work.[/b]
Windows 10 needed.

[b]Can't manage the game.[/b]
Don't use any live wallpaper before. Restart Windows if you had some. They block our wallpaper to run.

[b]Fences fixed?[/b]
Yes, fixed. Use your map but we recommend to start a new map.
 

All these corrections were made possible with your help.
Thank you very much. :D

If something is wrong, please write and we will certainly quickly correct it.

3DM

[h1]Hello our Desktop Farmers :D[/h1]

I admit that we did not expect such a big interest in our Desktop Farm.

This is our first game, but we have many other projects in the library and we are already working on new ones.

This, unfortunately, meant that we did not notice a few bugs when testing different settings.

Fortunately, many of you have helped us by locating the problems and proposing slightly different solutions. Thank you very much for that.

We corrected everything that was reported:

[b]Fixed Multi-screen support
Fixed Camera
Fixed Apple Trees
Fixed Roads
Fixed Fences
Fixed Cows
Fixed Grass
Fixed Save and Load
and a few more tweaks.[/b]
